Can I Hire a Property Manager for My Own House?

The idea of home property management, estate management, or hiring a property manager for a house you own and live in, has been around for quite a while. Leaving the administration of home maintenance & repairs to a 3rd party is highly desirable for both homeowners who value their time highly, and homeowners who are new to an area and do not yet have a rolodex of trusted contractors and vendors they can call on.

This post is designed to provide an overview of players in the space.

Currently Active

  • Bundl Home

    • Locations Served: Minneapolis - Saint Paul

    • Founded: 2020 by Jay Sachetti

  • BirdWatch

    • Locations Served: Washington, DC and Philadelphia

    • Founded: 2022 by Lisa Wise, Chris Rosenbaum, and Ryan Troll
